Whether economic complexity carries information beyond the income or wealth of a
destination zone.

## Setup

```{python}
import sys

sys.path.append("..")
sys.path.append(".")

import os
import pandas as pd
import geopandas as gpd

from si_plots import plot_eci_income_scatter
```

## Configuration

```{python}
FIGS_DIR = "../../figs/SI"
os.makedirs(FIGS_DIR, exist_ok=True)

CITY_ORDER = ["Bay Area", "Los Angeles", "Mexico City", "Rio de Janeiro"]

ZONE_PATHS = {
    "Bay Area": "../../data/h3_bay_8.geojson",
    "Los Angeles": "../../data/h3_la_8.geojson",
    "Mexico City": "../../data/h3_cdmx_8.geojson",
    "Rio de Janeiro": "../../data/map_informality_eci.geojson",
}

INCOME_PATHS = {
    "Bay Area": "../../data/income_proxy_bay.csv",
    "Los Angeles": "../../data/income_proxy_la.csv",
    "Mexico City": "../../data/income_proxy_cdmx.csv",
    "Rio de Janeiro": "../../data/income_proxy_rio.csv",
}
```

## Load Data

```{python}
zone_frames = {city: gpd.read_file(path) for city, path in ZONE_PATHS.items()}
income_data = {city: pd.read_csv(path, dtype={"geomid": str})
               for city, path in INCOME_PATHS.items()}

for city in CITY_ORDER:
    zones = zone_frames[city][["geomid", "eci"]].copy()
    zones["geomid"] = zones["geomid"].astype(str)
    matched = zones.merge(income_data[city], on="geomid", how="inner").dropna()
    print(f"{city:16s} {len(income_data[city]):5d} proxy zones, {len(matched):5d} matched")
```

## Complexity against the Proxy

```{python}
fig = plot_eci_income_scatter(zone_frames, income_data, CITY_ORDER)
fig.savefig(f"{FIGS_DIR}/s5_eci_income_scatter.pdf", dpi=300,
            facecolor="white", edgecolor="none", bbox_inches="tight")
```
